features.title: Fetch public X post text, photos and sampled video frames
features.summary: Give an agent a public X/Twitter post and quoted post, including photos and duration-aware video samples with a shared frame budget.
failureModes: Only HTTPS x.com and twitter.com status URLs are accepted; private, deleted, or unavailable posts cannot be retrieved.
The third-party FxEmbed API, pbs.twimg.com and video.twimg.com may be unavailable or return unsupported data; failed media is reported alongside available context.
At most eight media items are processed within 100 seconds; photos are capped at 10 MB and video downloads at 25 MB and 10 minutes.
Video frames scale with duration to a shared maximum of 24; ffmpeg must be on the DSH Host PATH, with frames capped at 16 million pixels and single allocations at 128 MB.
Only sampled still images are returned; frame times are approximate and audio and continuous motion are unavailable.

externalDependencies.boundary: The public numeric post ID is sent to api.fxtwitter.com; the response supplies post and quote text, author metadata, and media URLs.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The host test injects a fetcher that serves a fixed FxEmbed-shaped response from a local HTTP fixture; it never calls a public post API.

externalDependencies.boundary: Photos are downloaded from pbs.twimg.com and saved as image attachments.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The media tests provide photo responses using a controlled fetch seam and verify host and redirect restrictions.

externalDependencies.boundary: An MP4 variant is downloaded from video.twimg.com and decoded by the Host's ffmpeg binary.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The host test routes a video.twimg.com URL to a generated two-second local MP4, then uses the real download and ffmpeg sampling path.

verification.reason: Automated tests deliberately do not call FxEmbed or the live video CDN: availability and public-post retention are third-party concerns. The complete response, download, ffmpeg, and attachment projection path is exercised with local fixtures.
